Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl f(void) returning DAT_0109cf14, RET, body 004c14c0-004c1569. Double-checked lazy singleton whose construction is inlined to one store: 00bf681b(4) then *p = &PTR_LAB_00ce752c, so the object has no state beyond its vtable pointer. The vtable at 00ce752c is one slot, the scalar deleting destructor 004bbca0, which nulls the global and restores base vtable 00ce3818; no RTTI. All 20 call sites discard the result and each follows a formatted message (vsprintf_s in 004c7070, the profiler line '%s %.2f ms count:%d' in 00be3bf0) or a failed precondition (BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Lock, BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Lock), with five consecutive no-op calls in 0093ff10. Read as a diagnostic sink whose reporting method the shipped build compiled away; the output path is not recoverable from this image. Called at 0073e14b, one instruction after the 'After InitGui' checkpoint. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.
